headline_en: A rainy-day Sayulita: waves in the morning, tacos, spritzes and salsa by night
headline_es: Un día lluvioso en Sayulita: olas en la mañana, tacos, spritz y salsa en la noche
weather_en: Waves 0.7 m in the morning (beginner friendly), UV low, rain likely all day so bring a light jacket, sunset at 18:28.
weather_es: Olas de 0.7 m en la mañana (buenas para principiantes), UV bajo, lluvia probable todo el día así que lleva una chamarra ligera, atardecer a las 18:28.

stops.why_en: A central plaza cafe that locals and visitors use as their breakfast hub.

swap.why_en: A bright, welcoming vegan cafe for a lighter start.
swap.why_es: Un café vegano luminoso y acogedor para empezar más ligero.

stops.title_en: Learn to surf with Surf It Out
stops.title_es: Aprende a surfear con Surf It Out
stops.why_en: Waves are around 0.7 m with a 10 second period, ideal for beginners, and the water is warm so rain is no problem.

swap.why_en: A calm, family-friendly beach if you would rather skip the board.

stops.why_en: A seafood lunch spot, just right after a morning in the water.
